about_the_game:
Help out Melanie and Doc in two side stories that will unlock new shops! Melanie is in a designing slump, and needs your help for inspiration! Meanwhile, Doc is having trouble in the romance department! Can you help him out?

• Melanie's New Designs
• Reward: Seasonal outfits for the main and marriageable characters...42 new outfits!

• Doc's Romance Help
• Reward: Ability to change your house interior...7 unique interiors!
